question: How many meaningful four-letter English words can be formed using the first, third, fifth, and seventh letters of the word "PRACTICE" (when counted from left to right), using each letter only once in each word?
solution:
The 1st, 3rd, 5th, and 7th letters of the word “TITANIUM”
